# MONOLITH CODES

> MONOLITH CODES is a custom software development studio based in India, working with clients in India and worldwide. We design and hand-code websites, web applications, SaaS platforms, mobile apps, ERP/CRM systems and AI automation — no templates, no WordPress — and hand over 100% of the source code and IP to the client. Indian clients are quoted in INR, international clients in USD, with the same process and ownership terms.

Key facts:
- Founder-led studio: Anubhav Garg (Founder & Lead Technical Engineer) and Ankit Kumar (Co-Founder & Business Director).
- Starting prices: websites from ₹12,999 / $999 (2–4 weeks); web applications and SaaS MVPs from ₹29,999 / $2,499 (6–10 weeks); ERP/CRM and AI systems quoted per project (10–16+ weeks).
- Every project starts with a written scope and fixed quote; delivery is milestone-based with full Git repository handoff.

## Services
- [Custom software development services](https://monolithcodes.com/services): overview of all services, capabilities and starting prices
- [Website development](https://monolithcodes.com/services/website-development): hand-coded, SEO-ready business websites in React
- [Web application development](https://monolithcodes.com/services/web-application-development): portals, dashboards and internal tools
- [SaaS development](https://monolithcodes.com/services/saas-development): MVP to multi-tenant production platforms with billing
- [Mobile app development](https://monolithcodes.com/services/mobile-app-development): cross-platform iOS and Android apps
- [ERP & CRM development](https://monolithcodes.com/services/erp-crm-development): custom operations and sales systems, SAP/Oracle/Salesforce integration
- [AI & automation](https://monolithcodes.com/services/ai-automation): LLM integration, document processing and workflow automation
